description: Source code for the DataPayloadDecoder class, handling decoding of HTTP/2 data payloads in the quiche HTTP/2 implementation.

classes.name: DataPayloadDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for processing HTTP/2 data payloads, managing states for reading payload, padding, and handling frame boundaries.

methods.name: operator<<(DataPayloadDecoder::PayloadState)
methods.description: Overloads the output stream operator to convert PayloadState enum values to string representations.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Initializes decoding of a data payload frame, handling cases for padded and unpadded frames.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Continues decoding of a data payload frame, managing reading payload data, padding, and end of frame.
